spans.s: शम् vt. or vi. 4P (pp. शांत; pres. शाम्यति) 1. To be appeased, to grow calm, to become quiet or tranquil, शाम्येत् प्रत्यपकारेण नोपकारेण दुर्जनः K.S.ii.40, R.vii.3; 2. to put an end to, to destroy; 3. to stop, to cease, न जातु कामः कामानामुपभोगेन शाम्यति M.ii.94, शशाम वृष्ट्यापि विना दवाग्निः R.ii.14.With उप्-, 1. to become calm or quiet, Bt.xx.5; 2. to cease, to be extinguished.With नि-, to hear, to know.With प्र-, 1. to become calm or tranquil; 2. to be soothed; 3. to cease, to be extinguished; 4. to fade away.With सम्-, to be allayed, to be extinguished, सत्वं संशाम्यतीव मे Bt.xviii.28.

शम् Caus. (pres. शमयति-ते, शामयति-ते) 1. to appease, to calm, to tranquillize, to soothe; 2. to cause to cease, to destroy, to extinguish; 3. to remove, to avert, K.S.ii.56; 4. to tame, to subdue, to conquer, वैनतेयशामितस्य भोगिनो भोगवेष्टित इव च्युतो मणिः R.xi.59, R.ix.12; 5. to leave off, to desist.With प्र-, 1. to allay, to appease, to extinguish, त्वामासारप्रशामितवनोपप्लवम् Megh.i.17; 2. to vent, to remove, तमन्विष्य प्रशमग्नेर्भवितासि ततः कृती R.xv.47; 3. to adjust, to settle, प्रशमयसि विवादम् Sak.v.; 4. to conquer, to subdue.
शम् (II) vt. 10U (pres. शामयति-ते) 1. To look at, to inspect; 2. to show, to display.With नि-, 1. to observe, to perceive, to see; 2. to hear, to listen, R.ii.42, 52, 61.
शम् ind. A particle meaning- welfare, prosperity, blessing, health, (with a dat. or gen., e.g. शं देवदत्ताय or देवदत्तस्य).
सम् (I) vi. 1P (pres. समति) To be confused or agitated (according to some); not to be agitated (according to others).
सम् (II) vi. 10U (pres. समयति-ते) To be agitated.

सम् ind. When prefixed to verbal themes, it means ‘with, together with.’Sometimes it intensifies the idea contained in the simple root aud may then be translated by ‘much, greatly, thoroughly, quite, very,’ (e.g. संताप, संतोष).It may also express ‘completeness, perfection, or beauty.’It is sometimes prefixed to nouns in the sense of ‘same, like, similar.’As the first member of a compound, it means ‘with, near, before,’ (e.g. समक्ष).
साम् vt. 10U (pres. सामयति-ते) To conciliate, to appease.
शम m. 1. Tranquillity, rest, calm; 2. absence of passion, restraint of senses, Bg.vi.3, x.4; 3. allayment, alleviation, शममेष्यति मम शोकः कथम् Sak.iv., Sis.iv.62; 4. the hand; 5. final emancipation.

सम a. (f. मा) 1. Even, plain, level, संप्रति समदेशवर्तिनस्ते न दुरासदो भविष्यति Sak.i.; 2. same; 3. equal, समलोष्ठकांचनः R.viii.21; 4. convenient; 5. straight; 6. indifferent, impartial, fair; 7. common; 8. like, similar, e.g. क्षमया पृथिवीसमः; 9. free from emotion, unaffected by passion; 10. good, virtuous; 11. honest, just, upright; 12. full, compete, all, whole, entie.(समम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- 1. with, together with, (with an inst.), दुर्जनेन समं सख्यं प्रीतिं चापि न कारयेत् Hit.i., R.ii.25; 2. equally, e.g. यथा सर्वाणि भूतानि धरा धारयते समम्; 3. like, in the same manner; 4. entirely; 5. together, at the same time, simultaneously, सममेव समाक्रांतं द्वयं द्विरदगामिना R.iv.4.)

सम a. (f. मा) 1. Even, plain, level, संप्रति समदेशवर्तिनस्ते न दुरासदो भविष्यति Sak.i.; 2. same; 3. equal, समलोष्ठकांचनः R.viii.21; 4. convenient; 5. straight; 6. indifferent, impartial, fair; 7. common; 8. like, similar, e.g. क्षमया पृथिवीसमः; 9. free from emotion, unaffected by passion; 10. good, virtuous; 11. honest, just, upright; 12. full, compete, all, whole, entie.(समम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- 1. with, together with, (with an inst.), दुर्जनेन समं सख्यं प्रीतिं चापि न कारयेत् Hit.i., R.ii.25; 2. equally, e.g. यथा सर्वाणि भूतानि धरा धारयते समम्; 3. like, in the same manner; 4. entirely; 5. together, at the same time, simultaneously, सममेव समाक्रांतं द्वयं द्विरदगामिना R.iv.4.)

समा (I) f. (According to Amara’s lexicon this word is always used in the plural. Pāṇini, however, uses it in the singular.) Year, तेनाष्टौ परिगमिताः समाः कथंचिद्बालत्वादवितथसूनृतेन सूनोः R.viii.92, Bh.V.iv.36.
समा (II) m. With, together with.
शम-अंतक m. an epithet of the god of love.
शमथ m. 1. Calmness of mind, absence of passion; 2. a minister, a counsellor.
शमन (I) m. 1. An epithet of Yama; 2. a kind of antelope.
शमन (II) n. 1. The act of appeasing, soothing, consoling; 2. calmness, tranquillity; 3. cessation, end, destruction; 4. killing animals for sacrifice; 5. swallowing, chewing.
शामन (I) m. An epithet of Yama.
शामन (II) n. 1. Tranquillity, peace; 2. killing, slaughter.
समान (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Like, similar, equal, भुजे भुजंगेंद्रसमानसारे R.ii.74; 2. same, one, uniform; 3. good, virtuous; 4. honoured.

समान (II) m. 1. A friend; 2. one of the five vital airs which is essential to digestion and occupies the cavity of the navel.(समानम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘equally, similarly, like,’ जलधरेण समानमुमापतिः Kir.xviii.4.)
समान (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Like, similar, equal, भुजे भुजंगेंद्रसमानसारे R.ii.74; 2. same, one, uniform; 3. good, virtuous; 4. honoured.
शमन-स्वसृ f. an epithet of the river Yamunā.
शमनी f. Night.
शमनी-षद m. a demon, a goblin.
शमल n. 1. Feces, ordure; 2. sin, impurity.
समल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Dirty, foul, filthy, impure; 2. sinful.
समल (II) n. Excrement, ordure.
समल (I) a. (f. ला) 1. Dirty, foul, filthy, impure; 2. sinful.
शमित a. (f. ता) 1. Appeased, calm, pacified; 2. alleviated, relieved, cured; 3. relaxed.
शमित a. (f. ता) 1. Appeased, calm, pacified; 2. alleviated, relieved, cured; 3. relaxed.
समिता f. Wheat-flour.
शमिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Calm, tranquil, pacific; 2. one who has subdued his senses, Bt.vii.5.
शमिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Calm, tranquil, pacific; 2. one who has subdued his senses, Bt.vii.5.
शमी(मि) f. 1. Name of a tree, अग्निगर्भो शमीमिव Sak.iv., Yaj.i.302; 2. a legume, a pod.
शमी(मि) f. 1. Name of a tree, अग्निगर्भो शमीमिव Sak.iv., Yaj.i.302; 2. a legume, a pod.
सामि ind. 1. Half, unfinished, वल्लभाभिरुपसृत्य चक्रिरे सामिभुक्तविषयाः समागमाः R.xix.16; 2. vile, despised.
शमी(मि)-गर्भ m. 1. an epithet of fire; 2. a Brāhmaṇa of the sacerdotal order.
शमी(मि)-गर्भ m. 1. an epithet of fire; 2. a Brāhmaṇa of the sacerdotal order.
शमी(मि)-धान्य n. any podded grain.
शमी(मि)-धान्य n. any podded grain.
शमी(मि)र m. A small variety of the śamī tree.
शमी(मि)र m. A small variety of the śamī tree.
समिर m. Wind.
समीर m. 1. Air, wind, धीरसमीरे यमुनातीरे Git.G.v.; 2. the Śamī tree.
शम्या f. 1. A wooden stick; 2. the pin of a yoke; 3. a sacrificial vessel.
साम्य n. 1. Evenness, equality, parity; 2. likeness, similarity, साम्यं गतेनाशनिना मघोनः Kir.xvii.51; 3. equality, indifference, येषां साम्यस्थितं मनः Bg.v.19.
शामित्र n. 1. Tying up cattle for sacrifice; 2. killing animals at a sacrifice; 3. a sacrificial vessel.
शामिल n. Ashes.
शामीली f. A sacrificial spoon.
सम-आचार m. equal conduct, proper practice.
समाचार m. 1. Proper practice or conduct; 2. proceeding, conduct; 3. going, way; 4. information, report.
सम-उदक n. a mixture of buttermilk and water in equal proportions.
सम-कन्या f. a suitable maiden, a girl fit to be married.
सम-कर्ण m. an equidiagonal tetragon.
सम-काल m. the same time, the same moment.
सम-कालम् ind. simultaneously.
सम-कालीन a. contemporary.
सम-कोल m. a serpent, a snake.
सम-क्षेत्र n. an epithet of a particular division of the Nakshatras (in astronomy).
सम-खात m. an equal excavation, a parallelopiped one.
सम-चतुरस्र (I) a. equally quadrangular, square.
सम-चतुरस्र (II) m. an equilateral tetragon.
सम-चतुर्भुज m.n. a rhombus.
सम-चित्त a. equanimous.
सम-छेदन a. having like denominators (in math.).
सम-दर्शिन् a. impartial, शूनि चैव श्वपाके च पंडिताः समदर्शिनः Bg.v.17.
सम-दुःख a. sympathizing.
सम-भाव (I) a. of like nature or property.
सम-भाव (II) m. sameness, equability.
सम-मंडल n. the prime vertical line (in astronomy).
सम-मय a. of like origin.
सम-रभ m. a mode of sexual union.
सम-रेख a. straight, प्रकृत्या यद्वक्रं तदपि समरेखं नयनयोः Sak.i.
सम-वर्तिन् (I) a. impartial.
सम-वर्तिन् (II) m. Yama, the god of death.
सम-वृत्त n. a stanza whose verses are all alike (in prosody). See App. I.
समावृत a. (f. ता) 1. Enclosed, beset; 2. screened; 3. viewed; 4. protected; 5. shut out, excluded.
समावृत a. (f. ता) 1. Enclosed, beset; 2. screened; 3. viewed; 4. protected; 5. shut out, excluded.
समावृत्त m. See समावृत्तक below. Cf. अनूचान.
सम-वेध m. mean depth.
सम-शोधन n. equal subtraction, subtraction of the same quantity on both sides of an equation.
सम-सुप्ति f. universal sleep.
समक्ष a. (f. क्षा) Visible, being in the presence of.(समक्षम् is used adverbially in the sense of ‘eye to eye, in the presence of.’)
समक्ष a. (f. क्षा) Visible, being in the presence of.(समक्षम् is used adverbially in the sense of ‘eye to eye, in the presence of.’)
समग्र a. (f. ग्रा) All, entire, complete, full, Megh.i.56.
समग्र a. (f. ग्रा) All, entire, complete, full, Megh.i.56.
समंगा f. Bengal madder.
समज (I) m. 1. A number of beasts or birds, बकानां समजो विरेजे R.G.; 2. a number of blockheads.
समज (II) n. A forest, a wood.
समाज m. 1. A multitude, a number; 2. an assembly, विशेषतः सर्वविदो समाजे विभूषणं मौनमपंडितानाम् Bhartr.ii.7; 3. a convivial meeting; 4. an elephant.
सामन्-ज (I) a. produced by the Sāmaveda.
सामन्-ज (II) ??? an elephant.
समज्ञा f. Fame, reputation.
समाज्ञा f. Fame, reputation.
समज्या f. 1. Reputation, celebrity; 2. a meeting, an assembly.
समंजस (I) a. (f. सा) 1. Proper, right, fit; 2. correct, true, intelligible; 3. virtuous, good, भृशाधिरूढस्य समंजसं जनम् Kir.xiv.12; 4. experienced; 5. reasonable.
समंजस (II) n. 1. Propriety; 2. correct evidence.
समंजस (I) a. (f. सा) 1. Proper, right, fit; 2. correct, true, intelligible; 3. virtuous, good, भृशाधिरूढस्य समंजसं जनम् Kir.xiv.12; 4. experienced; 5. reasonable.
समता f. 1. Sameness, similarity; 2. equality; 3. equanimity; 4. right decision, M.viii.178; 5. perfectness.
समतीत a. (f. ता) Gone, passed.
समतीत a. (f. ता) Gone, passed.
समधिक a. (f. का) 1. Exceeding; 2. abundant, plentiful.(समधिकम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘exceedingly, excessively.’)
समधिक a. (f. का) 1. Exceeding; 2. abundant, plentiful.(समधिकम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘exceedingly, excessively.’)
समनुज्ञान n. Assent, consent.
समंत (I) a. (f. ता) Being on every side or part.
समंत (II) m. Limit, boundary, term.(समंतम्, समंततस् and समंतात् are used as indeclinables in the sense of ‘on all sides, from every part.’)
समंत (I) a. (f. ता) Being on every side or part.
सामन्त (I) a. (f. न्ती) 1. Bordering, bounding, limiting; 2. neighbouring; 3. universal.
सामन्त (II) m. 1. A neighbour; 2. a neighbouring king; 3. a tributary prince, कुर्वन्ति सामन्तशिखामणीनां प्रभाप्ररोहास्तमयं रजांसि R.vi.33, v.28; 4. a leader, a general.
सामन्त (III) n. Neighbourhood.
समंत-पंचक n. name of a holy place near Kurukṣetra.
समंत-भद्र m. an epithet of Buddha.
समंत-भुज् m. fire.
समन्वय m. 1. Natural succession or order; 2. connected sequence, application, सर्वेषां वेदांतवाक्यानां ब्रह्मणि समन्वयः S.Bh.; 3. conjunction, copulation.
समन्वित a. (f. ता) 1. Connected with; 2. fully endowed with; 3. affected by; 4. followed.
समन्वित a. (f. ता) 1. Connected with; 2. fully endowed with; 3. affected by; 4. followed.
समभिव्याहार m. 1. Mentioning together; 2. proximity or association with a word whose meaning is well understood; 3. association, company.
समभिहार m. 1. Repetition; 2. excess, surplus.
समभ्याहार m. Association, accompaniment.

समय m. 1. Convention; 2. agreement, treaty, contract, bargain, न समयपरिरक्षणं क्षमंते Kir.i.45; 3. engagement, appointment; 4. religious obligation; 5. an established moral rule or ceremonial custom, e.g. पतिव्रतानां समयानुरोधिनी; 6. rule, law, M.ix.273; 7. condition, stipulation; 8. order, instruction; 9. oath; 10. sign, hint, indication; 11. time in general; 12. the proper time for anything, season; 13. opportunity, leizure; 14. limit, boundary; 15. demonstrated conclusion; 16. precept, instruction; 17. end, conclusion, termination; 18. success, prosperity; 19. poetical conventionality, (e.g. the dance of peacocks on the appearance of clouds).
समया ind. 1. At a fixed or appointed time, in due time or season; 2. in the midst, between, within; 3. near, (with an acc.), समया सौधभित्तिम् D.K., Nal.iv.8.
समाय m. 1. A visit; 2. arrival.
समय-अध्युषित n. time at which neither the stars nor the sun is visible.
समय-अनुसारेण, -उचितम् ind. according to the occasion.
समय-अनुसारेण, -उचितम् ind. according to the occasion.
समय-आचार m. conventional practice or usage.
समय-परिरक्षण n. observance of a compact or agreement, Kir.i.45.
समय-व्यभिचार m. violation of a compact.
समर m.n. War, battle, यदि समरमपास्य नास्ति मृत्योर्भयम् Ve.iii.
समर-प्रदेश m. a battle-field.
समर-मूर्धन् m. the front or van of battle.
समर्चन n. Worshipping, adoration.
समर्ण a. (f. र्णा) 1. Asked, solicited; 2. pained, wounded.
समर्ण a. (f. र्णा) 1. Asked, solicited; 2. pained, wounded.

समर्थ (I) a. (f. र्था) 1. Proper, fit, e.g. किं समर्थं जनस्यास्य किं प्रियं किं सुखावहम्; 2. capable, allowed, प्रतिग्रहसमर्थोऽपि प्रसंगं तत्र वर्जयेत् M.iv.186; 3. made proper, prepared; 4. strong, powerful; 5. connected in sense.
समर्थ (II) m. The coherence of words in a significant sentence.

समर्थ (I) a. (f. र्था) 1. Proper, fit, e.g. किं समर्थं जनस्यास्य किं प्रियं किं सुखावहम्; 2. capable, allowed, प्रतिग्रहसमर्थोऽपि प्रसंगं तत्र वर्जयेत् M.iv.186; 3. made proper, prepared; 4. strong, powerful; 5. connected in sense.
समर्थक n. Aloe-wood.

समर्थन n. 1. Reconciling differences, allaying disputes; 2. potency, efficacy; 3. deliberation, decision on the propriety or impropriety of anything; 4. corroboration, support, vindication; 5. objection.
समर्धक a. (f. का) Granting a boon.
समर्धक a. (f. का) Granting a boon.
समर्पण n. Delivering, consigning, handing over to.
समर्याद a. (f. दा) 1. Limited, bounded; 2. near, proximate; 3. respectful; 4. correct in conduct.
समर्याद a. (f. दा) 1. Limited, bounded; 2. near, proximate; 3. respectful; 4. correct in conduct.
समवकार m. A species of drama; (thus described in the S.D.- वृत्तं समवकारे तु ख्यातं देवासुराश्रयम् । संधयो निर्विमर्शस्तु त्रयोंकाः).
समवतार m. 1. A descent; 2. a descent into a river or sacred bathing place at a Tīrtha, समवतारसमैरसभैस्तटैः Kir.v.7.
समवस्था f. 1. State, condition, R.xix.50; 2. similar condition or state.
समवाप्ति f. Attainment, obtaining.

समवाय m. 1. Conjunction, union, cohesion, connection; 2. multitude, quantity, concourse, collection, e.g. बहूनामल्पसाराणां समवायो बलावहः; 3. intimate union, constant and inseparable connection, inseparable existence or inherence of one thing in another, (one of the seven categories of the Vaiśeṣika system).
समावाय m. 1. Inseparable connection; 2. association; 3. aggregation; 4. number, heap, quantity. Cf. समवाय.
समवायिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Closely connected, aggregated; 2. multitudinous.
समवायिन् a. (f. नी) 1. Closely connected, aggregated; 2. multitudinous.
समवायिन्-कारण n. inseparable cause, material cause (in Vaiśeṣika philosophy).
समवेत a. (f. ता) 1. Come together, blended; 2. intimately united or inherent; 3. contained or comprised in a larger number.
समवेत a. (f. ता) 1. Come together, blended; 2. intimately united or inherent; 3. contained or comprised in a larger number.

समष्टि f. A collective aggregate, an aggregate which is viewed as constituted of parts of which each is consubstantially the same with the whole, हिरण्यगर्भाभेदेन ब्रह्मादिपदवेद्या समष्टिबुद्धिर्महानित्याह Govindānanda on S.Bh.i.4.
समसन n. 1. Combination; 2. formation of compound terms; 3. contraction.
समस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. Thrown together; 2. compounded; 3. abridged, condensed; 4. all, whole, entire.
समस्त a. (f. स्ता) 1. Thrown together; 2. compounded; 3. abridged, condensed; 4. all, whole, entire.
समस्या f. 1. Part of a stanza proposed to another person for completion; 2. proposing part of a stanza to another for completion, गौरीव पत्या सुभगा कदाचित् कर्त्रीयमप्यर्धतनूसमस्याम् Na.vii.82.
समांसमीना f. A cow bearing a calf every year.
समाकर्षिन् (I) a. (f. णी) Possesing a diffusive fragrance.
समाकर्षिन् (II) n. A scent spreading afar.
समाकर्षिन् (I) a. (f. णी) Possesing a diffusive fragrance.
समाकुल a. (f. ला) 1. Crowded, thronged; 2. bewildered, confused.
समाकुल a. (f. ला) 1. Crowded, thronged; 2. bewildered, confused.
समाख्या f. 1. Fame, name, celebrity; 2. appellation.
समाख्यात a. (f. ता) 1. Famed, celebrated; 2. reckoned up, summed up; 3. declared, proclaimed.
समाख्यात a. (f. ता) 1. Famed, celebrated; 2. reckoned up, summed up; 3. declared, proclaimed.
